ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central mass occupying ~80% of both lobe interiors. A thick, irregular low-intensity black band defines the left lobe trailing edge and distal tip. A narrow, more uniform low-intensity black band defines the right lobe trailing edge. Isolated low-intensity pixel clusters are scattered within the right lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth equal to ~12% of the fluke's total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular macro-serrations (notches). Right lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations with a significantly smoother linear boundary profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer margins of both lobes follow a steep convex curve sweeping dorsally and laterally towards narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single prominent high-contrast dark circular cluster located in the mid-section of the right lobe; several smaller, less defined dark clusters along the basal margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least four distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel tracks (rake marks) on the high-intensity white region of the right lobe, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic indentation and irregular tissue loss visible on the mid-to-medial section of the left lobe's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique star-shaped or cross-shaped black pigmentation mark is localized in the lower-lateral quadrant of the left lobe's white surface.
